title: Apple's newest iPad is the most boring iPad yet, and a major missed opportunity (AAPL)
text: Apple's newest iPad is the most boring iPad yet, and a major missed opportunity (AAPL) By Dave Smith Apr 2, 2018, 12:21 pm 11 pts Apple unveiled a new iPad last week. The new iPad is not very different from the 9.7-inch iPad unveiled last March. Apple could have done more to get people excited about the iPad, and missed some opportunities to sweeten the deal for the educational market, too. Apple unveiled a new iPad last…
